name: Paris
source:
A member of the White Mouse Clan serving [url=/c87444]Tsukuyomi[/url].
The middle child of the three mouse siblings, [url=/c87712]Daifuku's[/url] younger brother and [url=/c87714]Juliette's[/url] older brother.
He has been serving [url=/c74516]Tokisada[/url] since he met him at the Shikinjou bathhouse.
He has a calm personality, but can be strict with Daifuku.
